enum.name: MARV_CONFIG_SOURCE
enum.description: Where the running configuration came from.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_SOURCE_FACTORY
entry.description: The factory table compiled into the image: no stored config is active.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_SOURCE_ACTIVE
entry.description: A stored config (the active internal-flash slot) is running.

enum.name: MARV_CONFIG_STATE
enum.description: Whether the boot step accepted the config it found.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_STATE_OK
entry.description: The running config passed the boot step.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_STATE_REFUSED
entry.description: The boot step refused a config; MARV_IDENTITY.config_refusal says why. The vehicle does not arm.

enum.name: MARV_CONFIG_REFUSAL
enum.description: Why the boot step refused a config. The first set; later values append.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_REFUSAL_NONE
entry.description: Not refused.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_REFUSAL_FORMAT
entry.description: The file is not a well-formed config (magic, version, sizes or payload hash).

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_REFUSAL_SCHEMA
entry.description: A section's schema hash is not this image's parameter schema hash.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_REFUSAL_IMAGE_BINDING
entry.description: The config is bound to a different firmware image.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_REFUSAL_REPORT_BINDING
entry.description: The config is not bound to a validation report for this image.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_REFUSAL_VALIDATION
entry.description: A value fails the validator.

enum.name: MARV_ACTIVATION_RESULT
enum.description: The outcome of the last activation.

entry.name: MARV_ACTIVATION_RESULT_NONE
entry.description: No activation since the config was last reset.

entry.name: MARV_ACTIVATION_RESULT_ACTIVATED
entry.description: The staged config was verified at boot and copied into the active slot.

entry.name: MARV_ACTIVATION_RESULT_REFUSED_AT_BOOT
entry.description: The boot step refused the staged config; the previous config runs.

entry.name: MARV_ACTIVATION_RESULT_WRITE_FAILED
entry.description: Writing the staged config to the SD card or the slot failed.

enum.name: MARV_PARAM_ORIGIN
enum.description: How a parameter's current value came about (tools/config/mcfg.py, ParamOrigin).

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_ORIGIN_DEFAULT_FROM_CARD
entry.description: The default derived from the vehicle card.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_ORIGIN_DEFAULT_FROM_REGISTER
entry.description: The default from a parameter register.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_ORIGIN_MANUAL
entry.description: Set by a person.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_ORIGIN_IDENTIFIED
entry.description: Written by an identification or calibration run.

enum.name: MARV_PARAM_METHOD
enum.description: How a parameter's value was obtained (tools/config/mcfg.py, ParamMethod).

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_METHOD_PUBLISHED
entry.description: Published source.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_METHOD_MEASURED
entry.description: Measured.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_METHOD_IDENTIFIED
entry.description: Identified from data.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_METHOD_DATASHEET
entry.description: Datasheet.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_METHOD_DERIVED
entry.description: Derived by a rule.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_METHOD_DESIGN_BUDGET
entry.description: A design-budget entry.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_METHOD_SCENARIO
entry.description: A labelled scenario value.

enum.name: MARV_PARAM_SIGMA_KIND
enum.description: What the sigma of a parameter means (tools/config/mcfg.py, SigmaKind).

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_SIGMA_KIND_KNOWN
entry.description: Sigma is the 1-sigma uncertainty.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_SIGMA_KIND_EXACT
entry.description: The value is exact; sigma is 0.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_SIGMA_KIND_UNKNOWN
entry.description: The uncertainty is not known; sigma is 0.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_SIGMA_KIND_CHOICE
entry.description: The value is a design choice; sigma is 0.

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_SOURCE_OP_READ
entry.description: Request the chunk of the parameter's source text at offset (GCS to FC).

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_SOURCE_OP_DATA
entry.description: A chunk of the source text (FC to GCS, the answer to READ and to SET).

entry.name: MARV_PARAM_SOURCE_OP_SET
entry.description: Stage a chunk of the parameter's source text at offset (GCS to FC; offset 0 starts a new text of total_length bytes).

enum.name: MARV_CONFIG_ACTION
enum.description: A config command (core section 8 IF-11). Staging is PARAM_SET, not an action.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_ACTION_ACTIVATE
entry.description: Activate the staged config: write it, reboot, verify and copy it at boot. Needs report_id and expected_config_sha256.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_ACTION_REVERT_LAST_GOOD
entry.description: Make the last good config the staged config and activate it.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_ACTION_RESET_FACTORY
entry.description: Make the factory table the staged config and activate it.

enum.name: MARV_CONFIG_RESULT
enum.description: The answer to a config command. ACCEPTED means the action started; its outcome is MARV_IDENTITY.last_activation_result.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_RESULT_ACCEPTED
entry.description: Accepted.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_RESULT_DENIED_ARMED
entry.description: Denied: the vehicle is not disarmed.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_RESULT_DENIED_REPORT
entry.description: Denied: report_id is not the validation report of the staged config.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_RESULT_DENIED_HASH
entry.description: Denied: the staged config does not hash to expected_config_sha256.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_RESULT_DENIED_UNAVAILABLE
entry.description: Denied: there is no last good config to revert to.

entry.name: MARV_CONFIG_RESULT_FAILED
entry.description: The action started and failed.

enum.name: MARV_ARM_STATE
enum.description: The arming machine's state after a rate tick (fw/arming arming.hpp ArmState, same values): armed in ARMED, ARMED_HOLD and ARMED_FAILSAFE_CENTRED, else the cause of the latest disarm or the first refusing condition.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_BOOT
entry.description: Before the first rate tick.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_SWITCH_OFF
entry.description: The arm switch is off.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_SWITCH_NOT_CYCLED
entry.description: The arm switch was on when arming became possible; it must go off and on.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_THROTTLE_UP
entry.description: The throttle is not at its minimum.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_IMU_STALE
entry.description: The IMU missed its read deadline.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_IMU_INVALID
entry.description: An IMU sample lacked a valid gyro or accelerometer.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_SATURATED
entry.description: An IMU sample was saturated.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_NO_LINK
entry.description: No valid RC link.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_FAILSAFE
entry.description: Disarmed by the link-loss failsafe.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_MOTOR_TEST
entry.description: A motor test runs.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_ARMED
entry.description: Armed.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_ARMED_HOLD
entry.description: Armed, the link lost: the last sticks are held.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_ARMED_FAILSAFE_CENTRED
entry.description: Armed, the link lost: sticks centred and minimum throttle.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_ESTIMATOR_INVALID
entry.description: The attitude estimate is not valid.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_CALIBRATING
entry.description: The boot gyro calibration has not completed.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_NOT_UPRIGHT
entry.description: The vehicle is tilted beyond the arming angle.

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_CONFIG_REFUSED
entry.description: The config this boot uses cannot be used (MARV_IDENTITY says why).

entry.name: MARV_ARM_STATE_MAINTENANCE
entry.description: The maintenance grant was given: arming is refused until the next boot.

enum.name: MARV_MOTOR_GATE
enum.description: What the motor output gate passed to the motors on the rate tick.

entry.name: MARV_MOTOR_GATE_DISARMED
entry.description: Stop on every motor.

entry.name: MARV_MOTOR_GATE_ARMED
entry.description: The mixer's output.

entry.name: MARV_MOTOR_GATE_MOTOR_TEST
entry.description: The console motor test: one motor at the requested value, the others stop.

entry.name: MARV_FC_STATUS_FLAG_ANGLE_MODE
entry.description: The rate tick ran the attitude law (armed, angle mode selected).

entry.name: MARV_FC_STATUS_FLAG_AIRMODE
entry.description: The airmode latch is set.

entry.name: MARV_FC_STATUS_FLAG_ITERM_HELD
entry.description: Armed below the minimum throttle before the airmode latch: the rate integrator was zeroed.

entry.name: MARV_FC_STATUS_FLAG_GYRO_CALIBRATED
entry.description: The boot gyro calibration has completed.

entry.name: MARV_FC_STATUS_FLAG_ESTIMATOR_VALID
entry.description: The attitude estimate in use is valid.

entry.name: MARV_FC_STATUS_FLAG_UPRIGHT
entry.description: The arming machine's upright check holds.

entry.name: MARV_FC_STATUS_FLAG_IMU_INVALID
entry.description: A sample since the previous rate tick lacked a valid gyro or accelerometer.

entry.name: MARV_FC_STATUS_FLAG_IMU_SATURATED
entry.description: A sample since the previous rate tick was saturated.

enum.name: MARV_RATE_FAULT_FLAG
enum.description: Bits of MARV_FC_STATUS.rate_fault: the rate loop's fault state after the rate execution.

entry.name: MARV_RATE_FAULT_FLAG_ACTIVE
entry.description: The execution was a fault (zero torque).

entry.name: MARV_RATE_FAULT_FLAG_LATCHED
entry.description: The fault latch is set.

entry.name: MARV_ESTIMATOR_FLAG_MAHONY_VALID
entry.description: The Mahony filter's estimate is valid.

entry.name: MARV_ESTIMATOR_FLAG_ESKF_PRESENT
entry.description: The image runs the ESKF beside Mahony; without it the ESKF fields are zero.

entry.name: MARV_ESTIMATOR_FLAG_ESKF_VALID
entry.description: The ESKF's estimate is valid.

entry.name: MARV_ESTIMATOR_FLAG_ESKF_IN_USE
entry.description: The ESKF, not Mahony, is the estimate in use (ATTITUDE, the attitude law, the upright check).

message.name: MARV_IDENTITY
message.description: Identity and config state of the vehicle (core section 8 IF-1): the hashes and the validation report id that HEARTBEAT and AUTOPILOT_VERSION have no field for. Sent at a stream rate the GCS sets and on request.
message.field: The image's generated kParamSchemaHash.
SHA-256 of the firmware image.
The config hash (tools/config/mcfg.py, the sections this image reads) of the config that is running.
The validation report the running config is bound to (the report's SHA-256, or its id zero-padded on the right); all zero = none.
Factory table or active stored config.
Whether the boot step accepted the config.
Why the boot step refused a config; NONE when config_state is OK.
The outcome of the last activation.
1 when the staged config differs from the running one, else 0.

message.name: MARV_PARAM_RECORD
message.description: The provenance, lock and the active and staged values of one parameter (core section 8 IF-5). param_index is the parameter id, as in PARAM_VALUE. The values are the raw 32 bits (IEEE-754 binary32 for an f32 parameter, two's complement for an i32 parameter). The source text is read in chunks with MARV_PARAM_SOURCE.
message.field: The value in the running config, as raw bits.
The value in the staged config, as raw bits.
The 1-sigma uncertainty; 0 unless sigma_kind is KNOWN.
Parameter id.
Total number of parameters.
Length of the source text.
How the staged value came about.
How the value was obtained.
What sigma means.
1 when the parameter is locked (keeps its compiled value; PARAM_SET is refused), else 0.
Number of valid bytes in source_chunk (at most source_length).
The first chunk of the source text (UTF-8, no null terminator).

message.name: MARV_PARAM_SOURCE
message.description: Read or stage the source text of one parameter in chunks (core section 8 IF-5). Every operation names the parameter schema it refers to; a SET whose hash is not the image's kParamSchemaHash is refused.
message.field: The parameter schema hash (kParamSchemaHash) the sender means: the GCS's in a READ and a SET, the image's in a DATA.
Parameter id.
Offset of the chunk in the source text.
Length of the whole source text.
System ID.
Component ID.
READ, DATA or SET.
Number of valid bytes in chunk (0 in a READ).
The chunk (UTF-8, no null terminator).

message.name: MARV_CONFIG_COMMAND
message.description: A config command (core section 8 IF-11): activate the staged config, revert to the last good config, or reset to the factory table. Accepted only while disarmed, over USB. The command names the parameter schema it was prepared for; a hash that is not the image's kParamSchemaHash is refused.
message.field: The parameter schema hash (kParamSchemaHash) the GCS prepared the staged config for.
The validation report id of the staged config (ACTIVATE); all zero otherwise.
The config hash the GCS expects the staged config to have (ACTIVATE); all zero otherwise.
System ID.
Component ID.
The action.

message.name: MARV_CONFIG_ACK
message.field: System ID of the commander.
Component ID of the commander.
The action answered.
The result.

message.name: MARV_FC_STATUS
message.description: The flight composition's state after a rate tick that HEARTBEAT and SYS_STATUS have no field for: the arming state with its reason, the motor gate, the rate group's and the attitude law's counters, the IMU deadline misses and the RC frame age. A telemetry stream: its rate is set with MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL.
message.field: The rate tick's clock (time since boot).
Rate executions since boot.
The rate loop's faults since boot.
The rate loop's spacing faults since boot (of rate_faults).
The attitude law's faults since boot.
The attitude law's spacing faults since boot (of attitude_faults).
IMU read deadline misses since boot.
Valid RC frames since boot (wraps, skips 0); 0: none yet.
The age of the newest valid RC frame at the rate tick; UINT32_MAX: no frame yet.
The arming machine's state.
What the motor gate wrote.
MARV_FC_STATUS_FLAG bits.
MARV_RATE_FAULT_FLAG bits.

message.name: MARV_ESTIMATOR
message.description: The attitude estimators side by side after a rate tick (decision 0055, the ESKF in shadow): Mahony's and the ESKF's quaternions (Hamilton, body FRD to NED, w x y z) and gyro-bias estimates, and the boot gyro calibration's bias, which the gyro of HIGHRES_IMU has had subtracted. A telemetry stream: its rate is set with MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL.
message.field: The rate tick's clock (time since boot).
Mahony's attitude, w x y z.
The ESKF's attitude, w x y z; zero when the image has no ESKF.
The boot gyro calibration's bias, FRD; zero until it completes.
Mahony's gyro-bias estimate, FRD.
The ESKF's gyro-bias estimate, FRD; zero when the image has no ESKF.
MARV_ESTIMATOR_FLAG bits.
